frame_size_assumption.note: ODE does not publish IMAGE_LINES / LINE_SAMPLES in the product summary. Nominal NAC CDR dimensions are used to RANK candidates only; the winner's true dimensions come from the archive index table before acquisition, and acquire_real_pair.py refuses to clamp a window.
